subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in columns A, B and C to write five complete
stimulus: sentences. 1×5= 5 Column A Column B Column C (a) People do not eat (i) varies (i) depend on what they can grow or afford to buy from other countries (b) It (ii) depend largely (ii) all over the world (c) The eating habits (iii) the same food (iii) on its geographical of the people of a position, climate and soil country (d) That is to say (iv) the kinds of food that (iv) which grow abundantly people eat. in these regions (e) For instance, (v) eat a lot of fruits and (v) from place to place people in the tropical vegetables countries
guide_solution: Match Column A, Column B and Column C: (a) People do not eat the same food all over the world. (b) It varies from place to place. (c) The eating habits of the people of a country depend largely on its geographical position, climate and soil. (d) That is to say the kinds of food that people eat depend on what they can grow or afford to buy from other countries. (e) For instance, people in the tropical countries eat a lot of fruits and vegetables which grow abundantly in these regions.
